JMPY.me Marketing & Analytics Expert Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release providing a comprehensive set of tools for professional URL shortening, QR code generation, branded domain management, traffic analytics, and campaign orchestration using the JMPY.me platform.
- Supports full link lifecycle: creation, organization, updating, deletion, and advanced analytics for both short URLs and QR codes.
- Enables users to set up and verify branded/custom domains and subdomains for enhanced brand integrity.
- Includes campaign grouping and analytics for holistic marketing performance tracking.
- Provides setup guidance, trial information, and subscription status tools for seamless onboarding and account management.
